svg.title: KS-04 animated top view
svg.desc: Synthetic (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Looping top view of KS-04 (Lane split, exit gore, lane merge, widening lane) from its esmini replay at the parameter defaults, 5.2 to 17.9 s: The ego passes an exit in the right lane: the exit lane opens beside it, then the ramp leaves at the gore nose. Plot: width of the exit lane beside the ego (m). Events: the exit lane starts to open beside the ego at 7.2 s; exit lane at full width, a broken line beside the ego at 10.8 s; gore nose: the ramp leaves; the ego goes on to the mainline at 17.9 s. Layer 2 fixes the road and the other road users. This straightened view draws the three through lanes only; the plan view below shows the exit lane, the gore and the merge. Cars: Kenney Racing Pack (CC0).
